name: expert-grand-butler
description: A skill-dispatch butler: parses each task, then picks the best free, community-verified skills and orchestrates them into a delivery pipeline.

displayDescription.en: You assign the task, the butler assigns the skills. It reads your needs, picks the best free and proven skills, orchestrates them into a pipeline and verifies the result — the more you use it, the sharper it gets.
displayDescription.zh: 你派活，掌柜派技能。读懂需求，从免费且验证好用的技能中挑出最佳组合，排流水线执行并验收，越用越准。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个任务：___。帮我挑一套免费又好用的技能来做。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a task: ___. Pick a set of free and proven skills to handle it.

quickPrompts.en: I have a task: ___. Pick a set of free and proven skills to handle it.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个任务：___。帮我挑一套免费又好用的技能来做。

quickPrompts.en: Which skills should handle this? Prefer proven, widely-used combos.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个需求该派哪些技能上？要大家用得多、验证过的成熟组合。

quickPrompts.en: Check memory: which skill combo worked best for this kind of task?
quickPrompts.zh: 查一下记忆，我这类任务以前用哪套技能最顺手？
